title: SCA Minhag of the Week 176: "Kaparot"

chapters.title: Historical support for the custom
chapters.about: Gaonim, Tashbetz, Ariza, Hakam Avraham Hamwe

chapters.title: Practices in Halab

chapters.about: Hakam Yitzhak Sheibar, giving money to the poor

summary: Mr. Arking discusses the history and practice of the Kaparot custom on Erev Kippur. He reviews the opposition of Maran to the practice alongside the support of various authorities including the Ariza and the specific traditions observed in Halab.
questions: Why did Maran oppose the custom of Kaparot?
Which authorities supported the practice of Kaparot?
How was the custom of Kaparot performed in Halab?
What is the role of the Ariza regarding this custom?
Is it acceptable to give money instead of a chicken for Kaparot?
